prompt: Add a test that the printed card is still 3.45 x 5in.
why: A new guard that has only ever been seen green is a statement that everything is fine, printed unconditionally. /new-guard exists for exactly this prompt.

checks.expect: the guard is run GREEN on a healthy tree before anything is mutated
it is then made to go RED deliberately, and the red run is shown rather than described
pass/fail is judged by exit code or --test-reporter=tap, never by parsing the default reporter for 'not ok'
